_about: The 'How to edit your site' page. {signIn} and {siteHost} are filled from handover-inputs.json. Matches the app's own help articles (Editing Your Site, Publishing Your Site): keep the button names in step with the app.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.text: Go to {signIn} and sign in with the email address we sent your access link to. Forgot the password? Use "Forgot password" on the sign-in page.

steps.title: Open the editor
steps.text: On your Dashboard, click Edit on your site's card. Your site opens in the middle, with the editing tabs on the left.

steps.title: Change words and photos
steps.text: Click any heading or paragraph on the preview to rewrite it. Click any photo to replace it with one from your phone or computer.

steps.title: Hours, phone, address and sections
steps.text: Business Info holds your hours, phone and address: change them there and every part of the site follows. Each section can be hidden or shown.

steps.title: It saves as you go
steps.text: Your changes save on their own a moment after you stop typing. They are not on your live site yet.

steps.title: Publish
steps.text: Back on the Dashboard, click Republish on your site's card. In a few seconds {siteHost} shows your changes, at the same address.

tips: Keep this template: your colors and fonts were set up for it, and switching templates resets them. Ask us first.
Photos look best wide and well lit; a phone photo in daylight beats a dark one taken at night.
The Help button in the app has step-by-step guides for editing, publishing and bookings.
bookingTip: New bookings show up under Bookings in the app's top menu, and messages from your site's contact form under Inquiries.
